# Agent evidence conformance matrix

> One table of which agent-evidence projects shared open verifiers and conformance corpora can read, with a verdict, its basis and a replay command for every cell.

Each cell is marked "their records" or "our adapter" and carries one of five verdicts: agrees, contradicted, cannot-tell, unsupported, not run. `python build_matrix.py --check` refuses a stale table.

## Read the matrix

- [MATRIX.md](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-matrix/blob/main/MATRIX.md): the table, the properties table and the replay command for each project
- [matrix.json](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-matrix/blob/main/matrix.json): the cells, source of the table, with the revision each verdict was judged against
- [reviews.json](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-matrix/blob/main/reviews.json): one review entry per project

## Reproduce a cell

- [adapters/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-matrix/tree/main/adapters): the adapters and their recorded runs
- [records/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-matrix/tree/main/records): project records kept here because their source expires
- [libraries/RESULTS.md](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-matrix/blob/main/libraries/RESULTS.md): RFC 8785 and DSSE cross-library runs

## Add a project

- [README](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-matrix/blob/main/README.md): propose a project with a matrix.json entry, its adapter and its run output, and link its row with a badge
